# City of Pierre

> > Official website for Pierre, South Dakota, providing municipal services, utilities, recreation programs, and community resources for residents and businesses.

The City of Pierre serves as South Dakota's capital city, offering comprehensive municipal services including water, electric, and trash utilities, building and planning services, recreation programs through the Pierre Aquatic Center and Hyde Stadium, and community resources through Rawlins Municipal Library. The site is powered by CivicPlus and CivicEngage platforms.

## Key Topics

- Municipal Services
- Utilities (Water, Electric, Trash)
- Building Permits & Zoning
- Engineering & Planning
- Pierre Recreation Department
- Rawlins Municipal Library
- Pierre Volunteer Fire Department
- City Commission & Boards
- Code Enforcement
- Hyde Stadium
- Pierre Aquatic Center
- Business Directory
- Citizen Services
- Community Resources

## Resident Services & Utilities

- [Residential Services](https://cityofpierre.org/242/Residential-Services): Water, trash, electric utilities and municipal services for residents
- [How Do I...](https://cityofpierre.org/35/How-Do-I): Quick links hub for citizen services and common tasks
- [Report](https://cityofpierre.org/296/Report): Report power outages, street lights, potholes, and city issues
- [Code Enforcement/Property Maintenance](https://cityofpierre.org/631/Code-EnforcementProperty-Maintenance): Property maintenance code enforcement and violations reporting

## Planning & Development

- [Engineering / Planning](https://cityofpierre.org/158/Engineering-Planning): Engineering and planning services, zoning, and comprehensive plans
- [Building Department](https://cityofpierre.org/125/Development-Services): Building permits, planning, zoning, and development services

## Recreation & Community Programs

- [Recreation Department](https://cityofpierre.org/190/Recreation): Pierre Recreation Dept: pools, summer programs, and youth activities
- [Activities](https://cityofpierre.org/Activities): Search and register for city events and community programs
- [Hyde Stadium](https://cityofpierre.org/616/Hyde-Stadium): Hyde Stadium baseball field info, home of Oahe Zap and Legion teams
- [2026 Summer Programs - Unearth a Story](https://cityofpierre.org/692/2026-Summer-Programs---Unearth-a-Story): Rawlins Library 2026 summer reading programs for children
- [Adult Winter Reading Challenge](https://cityofpierre.org/747/Adult-Winter-Reading-Challenge): Rawlins Library winter reading program Jan-March 2026

## City Government & Boards

- [Boards & Commissions](https://cityofpierre.org/129/Boards-Commissions): City boards and commissions including Arbor Board and BID #1
- [Golf Board](https://cityofpierre.org/130/Golf-Board): Golf Board members, meetings, agendas and minutes

## Public Safety & Fire Department

- [Chief Officers](https://cityofpierre.org/452/Chief-Officers): Fire Department chief officers and leadership team
- [Patch Request](https://cityofpierre.org/456/Patch-Request): Request Pierre Volunteer Fire Department collectible patches

## Business & Community Resources

- [Resource Directory](https://cityofpierre.org/BusinessDirectoryii.aspx): Searchable directory of local businesses and community resources

## Optional

- [View](https://cityofpierre.org/299/View): Quick access hub for city documents and public records
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://cityofpierre.org/FAQ.aspx): FAQs about Riverside Cemetery burial services and fees
